arxiv-2303-01620.title: Estimating Heterogeneous Causal Mediation Effects with Bayesian Decision Tree Ensembles
arxiv-2303-01620.creator: Angela Ting, Antonio R. Linero
arxiv-2303-01620.description: Abstract The causal inference literature has increasingly recognized that explicitly targeting treatment effect heterogeneity can lead to improved scientific understanding and policy recommendations. Towards the same ends, studying the causal pathway connecting the treatment to the outcome can be also useful. This paper addresses these problems in the context of causal mediation analysis .

arxiv-2306-12571.title: Entanglement Transition and Replica Wormhole in the Dissipative Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
arxiv-2306-12571.creator: Hanteng Wang, Chang Liu, Pengfei Zhang, Antonio M. García-García
arxiv-2306-12571.description: Abstract Recent discoveries have highlighted the significance of replica wormholes in resolving the information paradox and establishing the unitarity of black hole evaporation. In this letter, we propose the dissipative Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model (SYK) as a minimal quantum model that exhibits entanglement dynamics with features qualitatively similar to replica wormholes.

arxiv-2507-23415.title: Nonlinear Magnetoelectric Edelstein Effect
arxiv-2507-23415.creator: Jinxiong Jia, Longjun Xiang, Zhenhua Qiao, Jian Wang
arxiv-2507-23415.description: Abstract The linear Edelstein effect is a cornerstone phenomenon in spintronics that describes the generation of spin magnetization in response to an applied electric field. Recent theoretical advances have reignited interest in its nonlinear counterpart, the nonlinear Edelstein effect, in which spin magnetization is induced by a second-order electric field.

arxiv-2508-17451.title: On The Space Complexity of Partial Derivatives of Regular Expressions with Shuffle
arxiv-2508-17451.creator: Davide Ancona, Angelo Ferrando
arxiv-2508-17451.description: Abstract Partial derivatives of regular expressions, introduced by Antimirov, define an elegant algorithm for generating equivalent non-deterministic finite automata (NFA) with a limited number of states. Here we focus on runtime verification (RV) of simple properties expressible with regular expressions.

arxiv-2602-08353.title: Towards Better Evolution Modeling for Temporal Knowledge Graphs DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence
arxiv-2602-08353.creator: Jiasheng Zhang, Zhengpin Li, Mingzhe Wang, Jie Shao, Jiangtao Cui, Hui Li
arxiv-2602-08353.description: Abstract . Temporal knowledge graphs (TKGs) structurally preserve evolving human knowledge. Recent research has focused on designing models to learn the evolutionary nature of TKGs to predict future facts, achieving impressive results. For instance, Hits@10 scores over 0.9 on YAGO dataset. However, we find that existing benchmarks inadvertently introduce a shortcut.

pmc-10597189.title: Piloting patient-reported outcome measures for evaluation of the Irish Chronic Disease Programme
pmc-10597189.creator: E Cosgrave, S O'Brien, M O'Brien, L Hurley, L Drummond, M Gleeson, D O'Keeffe, O O'Reilly
pmc-10597189.description: BackgroundThe Irish National Integrated Care Programme for Chronic Disease (ICPCD) aims to deliver end-to-end, patient-centred care across three clinical programmes; Heart, Respiratory and Diabetes. Patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) are a means of objectively measuring changes in patients’ subjectively-perceived health status over time in response to services.

pmc-10709733.title: Survival benefit and biomarker of PD‐1 inhibitor combination therapy in first‐line of advanced biliary tract cancer: A retrospective study
pmc-10709733.creator: Jingyi Guo, Qun Zhou, Mingzhen Zhou, Hengheng Dai, Lin Li, Yudong Qiu, Liang Mao, Baorui Liu, Jie Shen
pmc-10709733.description: BackgroundImmune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) combination therapies have shown promise in the first‐line treatment of advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC). However, the best partner remains to be validated. Moreover, progress on biomarkers predicting the efficacy of ICI in BTC is slow.

Many AL communities offer specialized memory care (MC), yet we know little about how their end-of-life (EoL) care practices might differ. pmc-12372935.title: Context-Dependent Roles of Four Classes of Bioactive Lipids in Neuroglia-Mediated Regulation of Neuroinflammation
pmc-12372935.creator: Shiqi Sun, Shuangyuan Hu, Yuyan Wang, Mingsheng Sun, Ling Zhao
pmc-12372935.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Neuroinflammation is an adaptive immune response of the nervous system to tissue injury or microbial invasion. As innate immune cells of the central nervous system, neuroglia cells—especially astrocytes and microglia—play a critical role in maintaining neural homeostasis. Bioactive lipids, key molecules at the core of tissue immune homeostasis, regulate a variety of biological activities with precision, participating in the management of neuroinflammation, a process often mediated by glial cells.

pmc-12469682.title: ALS Patients Exhibit Altered Levels of Total and Active MMP-9 and Several Other Biomarkers in Serum and CSF Compared to Healthy Controls and Other Neurologic Diseases
pmc-12469682.creator: Robert Bowser, Jiyan An, Kimberly Schwartz, Robert L Sucholeiki, Irving Sucholeiki, Maria Morello
pmc-12469682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Matrix metalloproteinases 2 and 9 (MMP-2, MMP-9) have been implicated in the pathogenesis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, their protein levels and correlation with other biomarkers are not well understood. pmc-12605013.title: SAG1.3-derived Frizzled-targeting small-molecule compounds
pmc-12605013.creator: Lukas Grätz, Ainoleena Turku, Pawel Kozielewicz, Carl-Fredrik Bowin, Magdalena M. Scharf, Jan H. Voss, Julia Kinsolving, Rawan Shekhani, Nuria Oliva-Vilarnau, Tobias Koolmeister, Marlies Körber, Volker M. Lauschke, Stefan Löber, Peter Gmeiner, Gunnar Schulte
pmc-12605013.description: Exaggerated Wingless/Int1 (WNT)–Frizzled (FZD) signaling contributes to pathologies, including fibrosis and different forms of cancer. Thus, targeting FZDs as WNT receptors for therapeutic purposes constitutes a promising intervention if the imminent risk of unwanted side effects caused by the involvement of WNT–FZD signaling in stem cell regulation and tissue homeostasis can be controlled. Here, we derivatize SAG1.

pmc-13654379.title: Antiplatelet Therapy Strategies in Patients with High Bleeding Risk Treated with Complex Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Descriptive Study
pmc-13654379.creator: Éloi Ravet-Claret, Susan Chen, Adèle Goulet, Dan Tcaciuc, Jamey Scraire, Léa Turgeon-Mallette, Marie Lordkipanidzé, Marie-France Gauthier, Julien Quang Le Van
pmc-13654379.description: BackgroundFollowing acute coronary syndrome (ACS) treated by percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI), guideline-directed dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) typically consists of 12 months of aspirin plus a P2Y12 inhibitor. Recent trials support antiplatelet de-escalation strategies in patients at high bleeding risk (HBR), whereas patients undergoing complex PCI are at increased thrombotic risk and may benefit from extended DAPT.
